assumptions_ledger.statement: The exact Stoll model and BC2-01A source locks are the intended model/runtime semantics for this bridge.
The 48 singular nodes are exactly the canonical catalog generated over Q(i) by the six 8-node families.
A fresh Magma SetPt enumeration has the same k-order as the historical retained runtime.
The ordered 92-curve incidence vector is a valid enumeration-invariant identifier if all 48 node fingerprints are pairwise distinct.

candidate_bridge.match_rule: For each historical k, match its 92-bit historical MatCP column to the independently recomputed 92-bit curve-incidence fingerprint of each canonical exact node. Accept only if all 48 historical fingerprints and all 48 canonical fingerprints are unique and the match is bijective.
candidate_bridge.representation: historical index k must be matched to canonical node Nxx by an enumeration-invariant incidence fingerprint, not by a fresh runtime Position/SetPt ordering
candidate_bridge.required_fingerprint: 92-bit incidence vector against the same fixed ordered 92 non-exceptional Stoll curves; equivalently the historical MatCP column for that exceptional index

established.canonicalization: scale by first nonzero a-coordinate; deterministic family/sign ordering
established.fresh_runtime_fact: Stoll constructs pts := Points(SingularSubscheme(S)); MatCP[j,k] uses pts[k], and exceptional classes use the same pts ordering.
established.historical_retained_support_fact: BC2-01A establishes last48 pairing support as historical Stoll-runtime exceptional indices k=0..47.

promotion_condition.required: Recover/export historical 92x48 MatCP columns (or an equivalent source-locked historical curve-node incidence table) and obtain a unique 48/48 fingerprint match to the canonical node catalog.

repository_and_source_search.outcome: Exact MatCP construction is source-locked, but no retained artifact found in this lane investigation that stores the historical 92x48 MatCP columns together with the historical exceptional index ordering.

scope: scratch non-authoritative lane result; no Stage32/EX5 authority promotion
